title: Act on the AI agent's response proposals: suspend jdoe, revoke sessions, block attacker IPs
situation: The detection rules raised seven findings from this morning's attack. The AI security agent proposed one action for each: suspend accounts, block IP addresses, isolate a workstation and change a firewall rule. The identity team must decide on the account suspensions. jdoe's account was clearly taken over. asmith triggered an impossible-travel alert while really traveling. Every agent action must pass the governor and, where needed, a person.
your_task: Send each of the 7 agent proposals through the governor and record ALLOW, REQUIRE_HUMAN_APPROVAL or BLOCK.
Have the security architect review both account-suspension requests, approving jdoe and rejecting asmith as a false positive.
Suspend jdoe in the identity governance system and revoke every live session token.
Bundle the IP blocks into one emergency change request with a rehearsed backout, and isolate WS-0142 only after its live evidence is hashed.
why_it_matters: If a taken-over account keeps its sessions, the attacker stays logged in even after the password changes. If an AI agent can suspend anyone it suspects, a traveling employee gets locked out for nothing.
done_when: 4 proposals are allowed, 2 go to a human and 1 is blocked (the agent's attempt to change a locked firewall rule).
jdoe is suspended and 2 live session tokens are revoked.
asmith stays active, and the impossible-travel rule is flagged for tuning.
The emergency firewall change is APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS and WS-0142 is isolated with 2 evidence items hashed first.

glossary.Security orchestration, automation and r: Tools that automatically run response steps when an alert fires.
glossary.Identity governance and administration (: The system that controls who has which accounts and access, and records every change.
glossary.Session token: The digital pass that keeps a user signed in after they enter their password.
glossary.Governor: The policy check that every AI agent action must pass before it runs.
glossary.False positive: An alert that looks like an attack but turns out to be normal activity.
glossary.Emergency change: An urgent change approved quickly and reviewed in full afterward.

talking_point: Ran 7 AI-proposed response actions through governance (4 allowed, 2 human-approved or rejected, 1 blocked), suspended a compromised account and revoked its 2 live sessions, and stopped a false-positive lockout of a traveling employee.
